ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.description: CausalContext binds messages to an ordered, fenced causal history.

causationId.description: causation_id names the immediate triggering event or command.

fence.description: fence prevents an expired lease holder from committing.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonically assigned by the canonical ledger.

traceId.description: trace_id identifies a separately authorized trace stream.

watermark.description: watermark records the complete source position observed by a projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.title: Causal Context

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.DraftPrReceipt.js.description:
DraftPrReceipt records the two-phase idempotent draft-PR publication.
 No merge, deploy, release, force-push, or branch-delete fields are expressible.

actionId.description: action_id is an opaque draft-PR action identity.

baseCommitOid.description: base_commit_oid is the approved base commit OID.

baseRef.description: base_ref is the exact destination branch under repository policy.

changeSetDigest.description: change_set_digest binds the validated candidate ChangeSet.

contentDigest.description: content_digest binds the deterministic title/body projection.

effectApprovalDigest.description: effect_approval_digest binds the separate current EffectApproval.

headCommitOid.description: head_commit_oid is the candidate head commit OID.

isDraft.description: is_draft is always true for a successful Tracer 001 PR receipt.

phase.description: phase is the current two-phase progress.
phase.title: Draft Pr Phase

providerPrId.description: provider_pr_id is the provider PR identity once created or reconciled.

publicationTupleDigest.description: publication_tuple_digest binds the immutable publication tuple.

receipt.description: receipt records the broker/provider outcome without secrets.

repositoryFullName.description: repository_full_name is owner/name for the target dogfood repository.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.DraftPrReceipt.js.title: Draft Pr Receipt

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.description: EvidenceRef identifies evidence metadata and optionally one precise anchor.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest identifies an optional canonical anchor serialization.

evidenceId.description: evidence_id is an opaque evidence identity.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id identifies the immutable source revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.title: Evidence Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.OutcomeFact.jsons.description:
OutcomeFact is a sanitized machine observation admitted after the draft PR.
 Raw traces remain under their original restricted scope and never elevate
 model proposals into evidence.

authorityClass.description: authority_class must be machine observation (never model proposal).
authorityClass.title: Authority Class

draftPrReceiptDigest.description: draft_pr_receipt_digest pins the admitted draft-PR receipt projection.

evidence.description: evidence references sanitized observation evidence only.

factId.description: fact_id is an opaque outcome-fact identity.

outcomeBundleDigest.description: outcome_bundle_digest pins the sanitized outcome bundle bytes.

rawTraceSeparated.description: raw_trace_separated is true when raw traces stay outside the admitted bundle.

receipt.description: receipt records admission without prompts, secrets, or raw source.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.OutcomeFact.jsons.title: Outcome Fact

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.description: Receipt records the authoritative outcome of an admitted operation.

causal.description: causal binds the outcome to replayable ordering and fencing state.

configurationDigest.description: configuration_digest pins the effective configuration without secret plaintext.

evidence.description: evidence records immutable inputs and outputs supporting this outcome.

operationId.description: operation_id identifies the command, run, or effect being receipted.

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a non-sensitive stable reason, never an upstream error body.

receiptId.description: receipt_id is a globally unique opaque receipt identifier.

recordedAt.description: recorded_at is when the receipt became canonical.

status.description: status is a stable, machine-readable outcome.
status.title: Receipt Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.title: Receipt

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ReviewDisposition.description:
ReviewDisposition is the overall fresh-review outcome for the candidate.
 Reviewer principal/model family must differ from every leaf implementer.

disposition.description: disposition is the overall review decision.
disposition.title: Tracer Review Disposition Kind

findingIds.description: finding_ids references typed factory ReviewFinding identities.

implementerFamily.description: implementer_family is the model family used for implementation leaves.

receipt.description: receipt records the review decision without raw prompts or traces.

reviewId.description: review_id is an opaque review identity.

reviewerFamily.description: reviewer_family is the model family used for review (for example gemini).

reviewerPrincipalId.description: reviewer_principal_id is the authenticated reviewer (never a leaf implementer).

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ReviewDisposition.title: Review Disposition

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerRun.jsonsch.description: TracerRun is one execution of the pinned manifest under one active variant.

activeVariant.description: active_variant is the fixture arm under evaluation.
activeVariant.title: Tracer Variant Kind

actorPrincipalId.description: actor_principal_id is body identity for authenticated-context cross-check only.

configDigest.description: config_digest pins the ConfigSnapshot used for this run.

draftPr.description: draft_pr is the two-phase draft-PR receipt when publication has completed.

manifestDigest.description: manifest_digest binds the run to one immutable TracerManifest.

outcome.description: outcome is the sanitized outcome fact when reingestion has completed.

receipt.description: receipt is the run-level non-sensitive outcome.

review.description: review is the overall fresh-review disposition when review has completed.

runId.description: run_id is an opaque tracer-run identity.

state.description: state is the current bounded lifecycle state.
state.title: Tracer Run State

steps.description: steps records per-step receipts in causal order.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerRun.jsonsch.title: Tracer Run

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerStepReceipt.description: TracerStepReceipt records one of the ten fixed tracer steps.

inputDigest.description: input_digest binds the immutable inputs of this step.

outputDigest.description: output_digest binds the immutable outputs of this step.

reasonCode.description:
reason_code is a public-stable Tracer 001 reason or empty on success.
 Required codes: SPAN_ABSENT, SPAN_STALE, SPAN_UNAUTHORIZED, SPAN_REVOKED,
 GENERATION_INCOMPLETE, BASE_STALE, FENCE_STALE, GATE_FAILED, REVIEW_BLOCKED,
 EFFECT_NOT_AUTHORIZED, EFFECT_DUPLICATE, OUTCOME_SANITIZATION_FAILED,
 REMOTE_RECEIPT_MISMATCH. External inaccessible shape remains not_found_or_denied.

receipt.description: receipt is the non-sensitive authoritative outcome of the step.

step.description: step identifies which fixed step this receipt covers.
step.title: Tracer Step

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerStepReceipt.title: Tracer Step Receipt
